issues.en: Surname from margin (Сервитови[ч?]ихъ); entry text Сервитовскихъ. Mother's maiden name garbled.

issues.en: The baptism day (15th) is earlier than the birth date (19 Nov) as drafted; kept as written. Priest's surname garbled (Montwid read from parallel entries). Family surname: margin Вин[г?]альтъ, text Вин галіовъ; used Vingalis [?]. Town name cut off after 'Плун'. Mother's maiden name kept in the feminine form as written.
issues.lt: Įraše pavardė „Вингаліовъ“, paraštėje „Вин[г?]альтъ“; krikštatėvio pavardė „Нагродзній“ neaiški; eilutė nutrūksta.
issues.pl: Na marginesie forma mianownikowa Вин[г?]альтъ, w treści „Вингаліовъ”. Nazwa miasteczka urwana (zapewne Płungiany). Brak formuły „со всѣми обрядами таинства”.

en.baptism: Three baptisms. (1) In the year one thousand eight hundred and fifty-one, in November, on the [day garbled, perhaps nineteenth] day, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, the altarist Fr. Wincenty Markiewicz baptised a girl named Chlbe with all the rites of the Sacrament. (2) In the year one thousand eight hundred and fifty-one, on the twenty-first day of November, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, the altarist Fr. Wincenty Markiewicz baptised an infant named Augustyn with all the rites of the Sacrament. (3) In the year one thousand eight hundred and fifty-one, on the twenty-first day of November, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, the altarist Fr. Wincenty Markiewicz baptised an infant named Jan with all the rites of the Sacrament.
en.parents: (1) Daughter of the peasants Wiktor and Ewa née Gudovna, Gizhevskii, lawfully married spouses, born in 1851 in November [day lost] in the morning in the village of Stol[…] of the same parish. (2) Son of the peasants Adam and Katarzyna née Pug[…], Valuzhis, lawfully married spouses, born on 21 November 1851 in the evening in the village of Varkoliai of the same parish. (3) Son of the peasants Antoni and Ewa née Davkovna, Surdlis, lawfully married spouses, born on 21 November 1851 in the evening in the village of Surbliai of the same parish.
en.godparents: (1) The godparents were the peasants Kazimierz Mich[…] and Anna, wife of Ignacy Kniustis. (2) The godparents were the peasants Antoni Buchnius and Barbara, wife of Augustyn Mozhiika. (3) The godparents were the peasants Kazimierz Aleiiunakh and Anna, wife of Franciszek Kazon.

issues.en: Three entries run together. Day of the first baptism garbled (looks like 'девятнадцатаго'); first girl's name garbled (Chlbe [?]). The first child's birth month is only partly legible. Village names uncertain. Surnames: Gizhevskii [?] (text Гижевыкихъ), Valuzhis, Surdlis; margin empty. Mother's maiden names kept in the feminine form as written. Second priest's name written Марневичъ, read as Markiewicz.
issues.lt: Trys įrašai vienoje eilutėje. (1) krikšto diena neaiški („де бно дцама го“), vaiko vardas „Чльбѣ“ (galbūt Elžbieta), gimimo diena ir kaimas neišliko. (3) pavardė „Сурдлювъ“ galbūt „Сурблювъ“; krikštatėvio pavardė „Алеяюнахъ“ perskaityta kaip Aleliunas.
issues.pl: Trzy wpisy w jednym wierszu, bez nazwiska na marginesie. (1) Dzień chrztu „де бно дцама го” (19?), imię dziecka „Чльбѣ” nieczytelne (może Albina), dzień urodzenia i nazwa wsi (Stol…) utracone, rok „851”. (2) Nazwisko panieńskie urwane. Wiele nazwisk chrzestnych niepewnych.

pl.baptism: Dnia 22 listopada 1851 roku w kościele parafialnym rzymskokatolickim w Płungianach ksiądz proboszcz Stanisław Wołontowicz ochrzcił niemowlę imieniem Jan z dopełnieniem wszystkich obrzędów sakramentu chrztu.
pl.parents: Syn włościan, prawowitych małżonków Jana [nieczytelne]lub i [nieczytelne] z domu Dowgalowna, urodzony dnia 22 listopada 1851 roku rano we wsi Płungiany, tejże parafii.
pl.godparents: Rodzicami chrzestnymi byli włościanie Józef Rusbsz i Marcjanna, żona Dominika Jasińskiego.

issues.en: Mother's first name and the first letter(s) of the family surname are lost ('-иваты', 'лубіовъ'); margin empty. The village is written 'Плунгяны' (rendered Plungė). A stray 'Кон' after Marcjanna ignored.
issues.lt: Motinos vardas („-иваты“) ir šeimos pavardės pradžia neįskaitomi; kaimas „Плугянахъ“ neaiškus.
issues.pl: Brak nazwiska na marginesie; nazwisko rodziny w treści urwane („лубіовъ”). Imię matki nieczytelne („-иваты”). Miejsce zapisane „въ Деревни Плунгянахъ” (wieś, nie miasteczko).
